quotes.text: Being in the program and winning with it are two different things. One is compliance, the other is strategy.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the episode's central distinction between program membership and strategy.

quotes.text: Pick two designations that align to your core revenue. Own them deeply. Build real capability. Get the certifications. Hit the usage metrics. And ignore the rest until you have capacity to expand.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear depth-over-breadth rule for choosing designations.

quotes.text: Co-sell is a two-way motion. You bring opportunities to Microsoft. And they bring opportunities to you. It's a partnership, not a delivery service.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects the common misconception that co-sell means Microsoft hands out leads.

quotes.text: Microsoft sellers are measured on cloud consumption. If your solution doesn't help them move that needle, they have no incentive to bring you into deals.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains what motivates Microsoft field sellers to partner.

quotes.text: And here's the key. The marketplace is not a listing. It's a sales channel. It requires active management, updates, and campaign support.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes marketplace presence as an ongoing sales effort.

takeaways: Start from the revenue stream you want in 18 months and pick two designations that match it, rather than chasing points across all solution areas.
Co-sell is a two-way, operational motion that needs a better-together story, seller-ready assets, an up-to-date Partner Center profile and active deal registration.
A transactable, MACC-eligible marketplace offer plus an internal operational engine for PCS, certifications and incentives turns program participation into revenue.
hook: Many Microsoft partners enroll in the AI Cloud Partner Program, collect badges and still stall out. This episode is for partner leaders at MSPs, SIs and ISVs, and it lays out four pillars, designations, co-sell, marketplace and an operational engine, plus a 90-day plan to turn program participation into real revenue growth.
